name: video-downloader
description: Download videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, and similar yt-dlp supported URLs.

YTDLP_COMMAND.prompt: Optional yt-dlp command or absolute path. Defaults to yt-dlp.

FFPROBE_COMMAND.prompt: Optional ffprobe command or absolute path. Defaults to ffprobe.

TWITTER_COOKIES_PATH.prompt: Optional Netscape cookies file for X/Twitter downloads that require login.

YOUTUBE_COOKIES_PATH.prompt: Optional Netscape cookies file for YouTube downloads/transcription that require login.

INSTAGRAM_COOKIES_PATH.prompt: Optional Netscape cookies file for Instagram downloads that require login.
